items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: I shared all this with my good friend and collaborator Matt Parker. He’s a saxophonist from Brooklyn. And so we started working on this tribute concert for Jimmy Knepper

ctx.x: Basic improvisation from the band director. You know they would maybe play some things, talk about some things, and then give us some kind of basic concepts to learn how to improvise. And I remember going to my friend Matt’s house, who was a saxophone player, and doing some things, just trying — you know he had play-a-longs, and so we were checking out the play-a-longs and in band. And I didn’t really see myself as a musician actually. And at that school when you left ninth grade that was you graduated junior…
